text: 1556 writes bad mbox content directly to storage, including missing From separators and unrelated rubbish, then observes asyncCompact failure. The accepted promise rejects from onFinalSummary with NS_MSG_ERROR_MBOX_MALFORMED; onCompactionComplete is not that rejection oracle. This tests storage scanning integrity, not a corrupted summary database or successful caller recovery. The commit subject’s MALFORMED_MBOX spelling differs from the actual MBOX_MALFORMED symbol. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: The malformed-mbox regression tests storage bytes independently of the summary database
